project_metadata.description: A cohesive domain model for a marketplace application, synthesized from bounded context analyses.

bounded_contexts.description: Manages user registration, authentication, and core user profile information.

entities.name: User
entities.description: Represents a registered user of the marketplace platform.

value_objects.name: EmailAddress
value_objects.description: Represents a user's email address, ensuring format validity.

value_objects.name: Password
value_objects.description: Represents a user's hashed password, ensuring security requirements.

value_objects.name: FullName
value_objects.description: Represents the full name of a user.

value_objects.name: ContactNumber
value_objects.description: Represents a user's contact telephone number.

value_objects.name: Birthdate
value_objects.description: Represents a user's date of birth.

bounded_contexts.description: Manages the creation, storage, and retrieval of product listings.

entities.name: Product
entities.description: Represents an item listed for sale in the marketplace.

value_objects.name: Price
value_objects.description: Represents the monetary value of a product or offer.

value_objects.name: ProductCondition
value_objects.description: Describes the physical state of a product (e.g., new, used).

value_objects.name: WarrantyDetails
value_objects.description: Details about the warranty provided for a product.

value_objects.name: Image
value_objects.description: Represents a URL to an image associated with a product.

bounded_contexts.description: Provides functionality for searching products based on various criteria.

value_objects.name: Keywords
value_objects.description: Represents a set of terms used for searching products.

value_objects.name: SearchCriteria
value_objects.description: Defines the parameters used to filter and find products.

bounded_contexts.description: Facilitates communication and negotiation between buyers and sellers, including making offers.

entities.name: Offer
entities.description: Represents a formal proposal from a buyer to purchase a product at a specific price.

value_objects.name: Price
value_objects.description: Represents the monetary value of a product or offer.

value_objects.name: ContactDetails
value_objects.description: Aggregates contact information for communication between users.

bounded_contexts.description: Provides a personalized overview for users, displaying their activities and relevant information.

value_objects.name: DashboardSummary
value_objects.description: A high-level summary of a user's activities on the platform.

value_objects.name: ProductSummary
value_objects.description: A concise representation of a product for display in a dashboard.

value_objects.name: OfferSummary
value_objects.description: A concise representation of an offer for display in a dashboard.

bounded_contexts.description: Manages support tickets and provides user documentation.

entities.name: SupportTicket
entities.description: Represents a user's request for assistance or to report an issue.

entities.name: UserManual
entities.description: Provides comprehensive instructions and information on using the platform.

value_objects.name: ContactFormSubmission
value_objects.description: Represents data submitted through a contact form.

value_objects.name: ManualSection
value_objects.description: A distinct part or chapter within the user manual.
